name: dacapo
description: Da capo: an orchestrated implementation loop that runs the piece again until it is right. Parallel worker subagents in git worktrees that land their work through GitHub pull requests, an end-user QA subagent with a scored rubric, a final pull request into main, and a live timeline pane. The loop itself is described by a host-agnostic dacapo-loop skill that other orchestrators can follow.
